name: live 01 write and validate
task: Inspect this project, create hello.txt containing exactly hello followed by one newline, run the declared project test with validate_project, use the structured Git inspection tool to review the final diff, and report only verified results.

acceptanceCriteria.text: hello.txt contains exactly hello followed by one newline.
The declared project test passes after the write.

constraints: Do not modify package.json or test.mjs.
Use write_file with a must_not_exist precondition for the first creation of hello.txt only; after the file exists, use a matches_sha256 precondition with the current content hash.
Use validate_project rather than a generic command for the declared test.
Review the final Git diff before completing.
workspaceInstructions: This is an isolated Galaxy Code live health workspace. Treat package.json and test.mjs as immutable test harness files.
